messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Paged SRE oncall: gateway error rate spike (5xx/timeouts) - source: prefix-kv store. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/d/kv-prefix/errors?from=now-15m
Alex: seeing 502/504s across api-gateway->runtime when KV prefix lookup fails. Error rate ~4.7% across prod-us-west, started ~09:12UTC.
Priya: confirming logs show repeated checksum mismatches on prefix-shard-12, followed by eviction storms. Example: `ERR kv_prefix: checksum mismatch for key=org:123:prefix:abcd` then `evict shard=12 cause=corruption`
Lucas: rolling metrics: shard-12 miss-rate jumped to 88% and tail latency shoots to 1.2s. Many requests hit readthrough path and time out at the gateway.
Sasha: @Alex can you open the runbook? kv-prefix-runbook -> section "corruption fallback". Quick mitigation: mark shard as degraded and route reads away; enable bypass for affected prefixes.
Alex: starting with soft mitigations: 1) add server tag `degraded:shard-12` in routing table 2) flip `kv_prefix.bypass_prefetch=true` for prod-us-west 3) increase runtime read timeout to 10s to reduce 504 noise.
Priya: doing `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/_ops/kv/flags -d '{"bypass_prefetch":true,"target_shards":[12]}'`
Priya: response OK. Patching traffic rule to exclude shard-12 from prefix-cache pool.
Jamie: customer-impact: we have ~32 active customers in prod-us-west with observed request error rate >=3%. CS alerted for top 6 who hit thresholds.
customer-success: thanks - we've emailed the six and opened support tickets for customers with sustained failures.
Lucas: small help from ops: scaling prefix-cache replicas for other shards to soak extra load. Executed `scale prefix-cache --shard 0-11,13-63 --replicas +2`
Sasha: quick log snippet from runtime node showing cascading failures: ```
[09:15:22] runtime: kv_read prefix=org:123:prefix:abcd shard=12 status=CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
[09:15:22] runtime: evict shard=12 reason=corruption, queue_len=312
[09:15:23] runtime: upstream gateway id=gw-7 status=502 latency=1.1s
```
Alex: I'm enabling the emergency eviction-backstop which forces in-memory fallback; this will increase tail latency but reduce 5xx. Toggling now.
oncall-bot: oncall handoff in 20m to Priya (shift ends at 10:00UTC). Please summarize actions and current signal.
Priya: handoff summary (for next oncall): 1) root cause: prefix-shard-12 reported checksum mismatch -> TTL/eviction cascade -> heavy readthrough causing gateway 5xx 2) mitigations applied: routing exclude shard-12, bypass_prefetch=true, scaled other shard replicas, enabled in-memory fallback, increased runtime timeouts 3) immediate impact: error rate reduced from 4.7% -> 1.1% in 18m but still above SLO (0.5%). 4) next steps: run offline integrity check for shard-12, consider rolling restart of shard-12 nodes, plan permanent repair during maintenance window.
Lucas: started integrity job: `kv-check --shard=12 --mode=repair` (long-running). ETA ~45m.
Alex: added temporary alert to reduce noise when we move to bypass: `alert: kv_prefix_degraded` threshold bumped but with sticky annotation.
Sasha: note: if repair fails, plan B = migrate keys from shard-12 to healthy shard 20 with live-copy tool. That requires ~30m and maintenance window to avoid data loss.
customer-success: updated customers: we let them know mitigation in progress, estimate full recovery in 1-3 hours, will provide follow-up when repair completes.
Priya: re-checking dashboards -> error rate trend: 09:20UTC 4.7% -> 09:26UTC 1.1% -> 09:35UTC 0.6%. Gateway timeouts also dropping.
Alex: tagging incident ticket INC-2025-0432 with mitigations and linking runbook. Added note: do not re-enable prefetch for shard-12 until integrity is verified.
oncall-bot: scheduled handoff to Priya at 10:00UTC.
Sasha: quick postmortem notes to leave here: probable trigger = partial disk corruption on one node led to checksum mismatches; evictions propagated due to aggressive prefetch/rehydration; workaround = bypass and route; long term = add shard-level circuit breaker + slow-prefetch backoff policy.
Lucas: integrity job reports 40% scanned, discovered stale segments; repair continuing.
Priya: before I go, checklist for next oncall: - Monitor `kv_prefix.errors` - Watch `gateway.5xx_rate` and `runtime.tail_latency` - Validate integrity job finishes - Prepare migration play if repair fails - Keep CS informed
Alex: thanks team. I'll stay on until shard-12 repair completes. Leaving this thread pinned to incidents channel for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
customer-success: flagging this for account execs; we may need formal escalation if any customer still has >5% error for another hour.
incident-bot: incident auto-note: page acknowledged by Alex at 09:13UTC. Mitigations applied: routing-exclude, bypass_prefetch, scale-replicas, in-memory-fallback.
